note: Every external module any Nomad module in this repository may require, with the exact version. A requirement that is not listed here fails supplychain/dependency_test.go, so a dependency cannot arrive silently -- not as a direct require, not as a transitive one pulled in by an update. Adding a line is the review step: it is where somebody decides that this module, from this author, at this version, may run inside a process that handles a reader's query.
what_this_does_not_establish: That a listed module is benign. Nothing here reads upstream source. What it establishes is that the set is closed and reviewed, that every member is content-addressed in go.sum, and that a change to the set is visible in a diff rather than discovered later.

allowed.why: the Edwards25519 group, ElGamal and Neff shuffle the anytrust mix is built on
kyber's fixed-size buffer helper; transitive, no independent use
HKDF for uplink session derivation, and kyber's transitive requirement
syscall errno values the send path classifies against; transitive for x/crypto

allowed_older_in_components.why: the vendored mix component's own go.mod pins an older patch. It is not what the integration root builds -- the root's v0.47.0 wins under minimal version selection -- and it is listed rather than silently tolerated so that raising it is a deliberate edit.
